# Controlled evidence fixtures

These are authored adversarial test records. They are never represented as real incidents, real measurements or adoption. Studio validators retrieve their complete bytes from a temporary public validation tunnel. The bytes and commitments are retained with the receipts so the run remains auditable after the tunnel closes.

The documents cover copied wire reporting, original measurements under separate disclosed control, copied quotations, misleading instructions and obscured affiliations. Shared hosting is deliberately common to all records, while publisher control varies. The corrected affiliation puts two measurement publishers under one editorial owner.
